page.overview:
What is Bouncepot?

is an enemy encountered in FNaF World. It is encountered in Fazbear Hills.

Bouncepot has the appearance of a onion-like plant creature with a spiraled stem, two vines waving around that appear to act as its arms, and flies that swirl on either side of it. Its eyes are black with white pupils, and its body is green, with the head being a lighter shade. It is seen inside a wooden pot shaped like a beehive. On the top of its head, it has two leaves that are constantly bouncing around.

"You've been through a lot. I am ready to reveal myself."

"You see. I've been there all along. It was me."
